# Temple Scroll Column 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 11 | **Condition:** heavily damaged / fragmentary

---

**11:1** [...] On the first day of the seventh month, you are to gather for a sacred assembly [...]

**11:2** [...] You must not do any heavy labor [...]

**11:3** [...] This is to be your day of remembrance, celebrated with the blowing of trumpets [...]

**11:4** [...] a memorial before Me [...]

**11:5** [...] You are to bring a burnt offering, a fire offering whose aroma pleases the LORD [...]

**11:6** [...] one young bull, one ram [...]

**11:7** [...] and seven one-year-old lambs, all without defect [...]

**11:8** [...] Along with their grain offering of fine flour blended with oil — three-tenths of a measure for the bull [...]

**11:9** [...] two-tenths for the ram [...]

**11:10** [...] and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs [...]

**11:11** [...] Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you [...]

**11:12** [...] This is in addition to the new moon burnt offering and its grain offering [...]

**11:13** [...] and the regular daily burnt offering with its grain offering and their drink offerings [...]

**11:14** [...] as prescribed — a fire offering whose aroma pleases the LORD [...]

**11:15** [...] This is a lasting requirement for all your generations [...]

**11:16** [...] wherever you live [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 11 survives only in fragments. The content establishes the observance of the first day of the seventh month — a day of trumpet blasts and remembrance. God speaks directly, commanding the offerings. The prescriptions mirror Numbers 29:1-6 but in the Temple Scroll's distinctive first-person divine voice. Damaged portions indicated by [...]; readable text rendered for accessibility.*
